scope: Trusted fixed fixtures only. Compilation/reflection is verified; D3D12 execution and two-API image equivalence remain B1 acceptance work (renderer-7ft.2.3 and renderer-7ft.2.4).

coordinates.input: Same model positions and column-major clip_from_model bytes as Vulkan
coordinates.vertex_y: Negate clip-space Y in both generated vertex shaders to match positive-height Vulkan viewport orientation with a positive D3D12 viewport
coordinates.raster: Normal Z, clear depth 1, LESS, cull NONE, blending disabled; front-face/culling equivalence is not established
coordinates.pixel: Top-left image coordinates and pixel-center SV_Position.xy; integer truncation selects the same texel
coordinates.color: Linear RGBA8_UNORM, alpha preserved; no filtering, sRGB conversion, HDR, or tone mapping

image.comp.capability: D3D12_FORMAT_SUPPORT2_UAV_TYPED_LOAD and UAV_TYPED_STORE for DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM; DXIL declares Typed UAV Load Additional Formats
image.comp.constant_binding: DXC assigned and reflected b0; SPIRV-Cross emits an unregistered cbuffer
image.comp.bounds: Host must require equal nonzero source/destination extents; shader guards destination bounds for ceil-divided dispatch
image.comp.choice: Keep default storage-image UAV mapping; do not use SPIRV-Cross's type-system-sensitive --hlsl-nonwritable-uav-texture-as-srv option

mesh.vert.constant_binding: DXC assigned and reflected b0/space0; SPIRV-Cross emits an unregistered cbuffer
mesh.vert.matrix: Generated row_major float4x4 and mul(position, matrix) together preserve the original column-major host payload. Do not transpose or repack CPU bytes.
mesh.vert.output: TEXCOORD0 linear float4 color and SV_Position

composite.vert.input: SV_VertexID, fullscreen non-indexed triangle, vertex count 3, start vertex 0

composite.frag.sampler: SPIRV-Cross splits the combined sampler declaration, but texelFetch becomes Texture2D.Load. DXC removes unused s0; the checked-in reflection verifies no active sampler.
composite.frag.output: SV_Target0 float4, source and destination extents must match

constant_allocation: Logical member offsets and sizes do not replace D3D12 root-constant/CBV placement and range requirements. Product runtime chooses and validates the binding in later tasks.
verification: Regeneration compares pinned tools, source/SPIR-V hashes, generated HLSL, validated DXIL, and DXC signature/binding/offset reflection. Nonidentity MVP, off-center geometry, depth, colors, and every output pixel still require real GPU comparison.
